zoe (devex): FYI customers reported duplicate rows in quota dashboard after the new routehash change. Small, noisy but confusing.

omar (eng-platform): Thanks — suspected cause: different SDKs creating different fingerprints for the same logical route. Need quick mitigation.

felix (sdk-python): py-sdk emits routehash based on (tenant, shard, priority) where priority was a symbol in 2.x and string in 3.x. We'll push a small compatibility layer to coerce priority to string.

kai (sdk-ts): ts-sdk did a stable-hash change last week which altered ordering of keys before hashing. That explains the mismatch. We can add a flag to restore legacy ordering for a release window.

ingest-bot: scheduled task normalize-routehash-v1 (task-221) queued for 15min.

zoe (devex): short-term: console can collapse rows that resolve to the same logical parsed route and show a tooltip "Normalized routehash equivalents". Will draft banner.

omar (eng-platform): plan: 1) ingest normalize job to canonicalize parsed fields and emit canonical_route_id. 2) SDK compat releases (py/ts/go) with shims. 3) update API docs with routehash derivation. Avoid router-level changes during canary.

felix (sdk-python): I'll open PR for 2.3.1 with coercion and a migration note.

kai (sdk-ts): will ship a 3.2.2 with legacy ordering toggle and docs.

zoe (devex): action items assigned. I'll post to status page and ping customers with pinned dependencies.

omar (eng-platform): I'll monitor quota divergence and keep the fix behind a feature flag. Reopen if anything flares. :+1:
